options.name: create_image
options.description: Creates the complete boot image with I(image_name) in I(directory).

options.name: directory
options.description: Specifies the directory in which the boot image will be stored.

options.name: image_name
options.description: Specifies the name of the output image from the bosboot command. The image will be stored in/as 'directory/image_name'. If both directory and image_name are not given, the default value will be used i.e. The image will be saved as "/tmp/lv.bosboot"

options.name: increase_space
options.description: Takes user permession to increase the file space.

options.name: only_verify
options.description: Verify, but do not build boot image for I(directory) and I(image_name).

options.name: prototype_file
options.description: Uses the specified prototype file for the RAM disk file system.

options.name: table_entry
options.description: Specifies which boot pointer table entry to update. C(primary) Specifies the table entry that was most recently used. C(standby) Specifies the table entry that was not most recently used. C(both) Specifies both boot pointer table entries.
